newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse to investigate Cerus leaks.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse to investigate Cerus leaks.

text.p: The Paris COB stockmarket regulator said on Wednesday it was opening an inquiry into the release of information concerning a possible buy-out by investment company CGIP of the Cerus holding group and car parts maker Valeo.

"In view of the information published in the last few days concerning a possible buy-out by the CGIP of Cerus and Valeo, the COB has decided to open an inquiry as required by its rules on the disclosure of information and has advised the persons concerned," a spokeswoman for the Commission des Operations de Bourse told Reuters.
French newspapers have this week carried detailed reports of a possible buy-out by CGIP of Cerus and Valeo.
CGIP denied on Tuesday the reports of a public offer for Cerus and Valeo but said it was in talks with Italian businessman Carlo De Bernadetti.
The CGIP denial, made during trading hours, sent Cerus and Valeo shares sharply lower and both were suspended limit-down.
The CGIP statement was followed by a brief denial by electronics firm Sagem, also in trading hours, that it had agreed to take a stake in Valeo, as reported by French financial daily Les Echos.
